info.name: In Search for the Lost Memory

descriptions.notStarted: According to the Memory Keeper, in order to find my lost memory, I need to go back to the starting point of my adventure.  Starting point of my adventure? Let's see... Wouldn't that be when I left Maple Island to Victoria Island for the first time and got my job?  I should go see #b#p1012100##k.
descriptions.inProgress: It had been a long time since I last met with #p1012100#.  He said he remembered back when I was just a beginner and I knew nothing. He was happy to see how I've grown into a great archer  I was touched that he still remembered our first meeting from such a long time ago.
